Municipality
              of

     P.O Box 390                  GIRDWOOD VALLEY SERVICE AREA BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
      Girdwood, Alaska 99587                               Jennifer Wingard & Kellie Okonek, Co-Chairs
      http://www.muni.org/gbos                              Brian Burnett, Amanda Tuttle, Nick Crews
    Suzanne LaFrance, Mayor
                         September 28 2026
           GBOS Special Meeting: GVSA Grant Presentations
                              Minutes Draft
         6 p.m. via Microsoft Teams & Girdwood Community Room
This hybrid meeting is taking place via Microsoft Teams and at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd..

The Girdwood Board of Supervisors, its committees, and subcommittees are subject to the Alaska Open Meetings Act
as found in Alaska Statute 44.62.310 and Anchorage Municipal Code1.25 - Public Meetings.
The Girdwood Board of Supervisors operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order Jennifer Wingard, Co-Chair
Land Acknowledgement: The Girdwood Board of Supervisors acknowledges the indigenous peoples of Alaska, whose land we
reside on. The community of Girdwood, situated between the areas known to be Dena'ina and Alutiiq homeland, respects the people
who were stewards of this land for generations. We commit to the continued stewardship of this land and are grateful to be part of a
wider community that seeks to maintain a sustainable use of Girdwood Valley for present and future peoples.

Roll Call: Attending are Brian Burnett (BB), Nick Crews (NC), Amanda Tuttle (AT), Jennifer Wingard (JW)
Kellie Okonek is excused

Disclosures: it is acknowledged that most members of GBOS are involved in local non-profits.
Brian Burnett takes chair for JW disclosure.
JW discloses that there may be a small financial contribution to her son from TAMS. Chair determines no conflict.
JW returns to chair.
AT discloses that her business relies on transportation from GVT. It is noted that GVT is hard-funded and there is not
a vote on the amount of funding. Chair determines no conflict.

Agenda Revisions and Approval
September 28 2026 GVSA Non-Profit Recreation Grant Presentation agenda approved BB/AT  Assent
1.     Review of grant process (Staff and Brian Burnett) See meeting packet for this information.
       Review Budget funding for 2027 GVSA Non-Profit Grants, Instructions, Evaluation criteria and
       Confirmation of final grant distributions procedure and date
2.      Presentations by 2027 grant applicants: See meeting packet for application and review information
       Turnagain Arm Mycological Society; Challenge Alaska; Girdwood Art Institute; Girdwood Community Club;
        Glacier Valley Transit; Little Bears Playhouse; Four Valleys Community School; Girdwood Arts Council
3.     PSAC Vacancy
     GBOS received nomination from Cody Rice to serve on PSAC.
       Motion:
     GBOS moves to accept the nomination of Cody Rice.
       Motion by AT/BB
       Motion carries 4-0 in roll call vote.

PUBLIC COMMENT:    Amanda Thompson expresses support for grants.
Adjourn 7:35PM

           GBOS Meeting Agendas and minutes are available on line: http://www.muni.org/gbos
